thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/14/2019: AXTI, CAMT, MAXR, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/14/2019: AXTI, CAMT, MAXR, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.80%
AAPL: -0.75%
IBM: -0.50%
CSCO: -0.62%
GOOG: -0.87%
Technology stocks were declining in Monday's pre-market trading .
Early movers include:
(-) AXT ( AXTI ), which was down more than 9% as it updated its expectations for Q4 results, which are scheduled to be announced Feb. 20, saying it now expects Q4 revenue to be in the range of $22.0 million to $22.4 million, a decline from the previous forecast.
(+) Camtek ( CAMT ) was edging over 5% higher as the manufacturer of semiconductor technology reaffirmed Q4 revenue guidance between $32.5 million and $33.5 million, straddling the Street estimate of $33 million, and said it expects sequential revenue growth in Q1.
(+) Maxar Technologies ( MAXR ) was more than 4% higher after it appointed Daniel Jablonsky as president and chief executive officer, succeeding Howard Lance, who has resigned from his roles as president and CEO and as a director.
